notes: Astral Foods Limited (JSE: ARL) — South Africa's largest integrated poultry producer. Two divisions: Poultry (County Fair, Festive, Goldi brands — broiler grow-out, processing) and Feed (Meadow Feeds, the country's largest animal-feed business, sells externally and intercompany). Fiscal year ends 30 September. Dual challenge over FY22-FY24: (1) load-shedding (electricity rationing) which forced diesel generator running; (2) avian-influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in mid-2023 destroyed ~2M breeder hens, requiring R220M government grant + multi-year flock rebuild; (3) high feed-grain prices (yellow maize, soy meal). FY24 was a recovery year as power supply normalized and feed costs eased. Annual report at astralfoods.com/investors/.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue R14.8B. Op profit R590M. Net cash R650M (no debt). COVID disruptions to QSR / hospitality demand.
FY21: revenue R16.4B (+11%). HEPS 1,463 cents. Op profit ~R740M. Cash position strong, no debt.
FY22: revenue R18.6B. Load-shedding intensifies. Diesel costs R741M (vs R8M FY21). Op profit R860M. Cash drawn down for working-capital.
FY23: ANNUS HORRIBILIS. Revenue R19.7B but op LOSS R(977M). HPAI culls (2M breeder hens) + record load-shedding + feed-cost squeeze. Net debt swung to R380M. Dividend suspended. Worst year on record.
H1 FY23 (Apr 22-Mar 23 H1): squeezed by feed costs.

FY24: powerful recovery. Revenue R22.5B (+14%). Op profit R972M (vs R-977M loss FY23). HEPS ~2,250 cents. Load-shedding eased; AI flock rebuilt; feed-grain costs lower. Net cash position restored. Dividend reinstated 975 cents.
